title: anti-diagonal win broken
acceptance_criteria: Win detection correctly returns a winner for the anti-diagonal 2-4-6 line
Other win paths (rows, columns, main diagonal) continue to pass the existing test suite
No files outside allowed_paths are modified

sensor_context.message:
GitHub issue #3: anti-diagonal win broken
Win on squares 2-4-6 is reported as null. Please fix tictactoe.js.
Triage: Issue #3 in johwes/tic-tac-toe reports that winning on the anti-diagonal (squares 2-4-6) returns null instead of a winner, indicating a bug in the win-line definitions or index checks in tictactoe.js. Minimal fix is confined to tictactoe.js; tests are forbidden from modification and verification runs via node --test with the existing test file.
